programme.title: Citra Exclusive: Tergantung Rindu
programme.desc: Kisah 2 beradik yang terpisah disebabkan hutang bapa saudara mereka berusaha untuk bertemu semula Mereka mengumpul duit dengan menjadi pemuzik jalanan.

programme.title: Amir & Loqman Pergi Ke Laut

programme.title: Awak Terlalu Ganu Untuk Saya
programme.desc: Mateen falls in love with a girl who is phobic about people from Terengganu. With Teja's help, Mateen pretends to be from Kuala Lumpur.

programme.title: Karya 12 - Roti Canai Love Story
programme.desc: Kisah hubungan persahabatan di antara kanak-kanak berbangsa Melayu dan Cina yang bermula dari kisah sekeping roti canai dan konflik keluarga mereka.

programme.title: Karya 12 - Roti Canai Love Story
programme.desc: Kisah hubungan persahabatan di antara kanak-kanak berbangsa Melayu dan Cina yang bermula dari kisah sekeping roti canai dan konflik keluarga mereka.

programme.title: Syaaban

programme.title: Mael Lambong

programme.title: Jutawan Fakir

programme.title: Suara Kekasih

programme.title: Attack on Titan Final Season Ep2

programme.title: Attack on Titan Final Season Ep3

programme.title: An Archdemon's Dilemma How to Love Your Elf Bride Ep6

programme.title: Magical Explorer Ep6
programme.desc: Reborn in a dating sim as a comic-relief side character with unexpected hidden powers, Kousuke, armed with extensive knowledge of the game, seeks a happy ending with the heroines he admires.

programme.title: The Ancient Magus' Bride: Ep8

programme.title: The Dangers in My Heart Ep8

programme.title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life Ep1

programme.title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life Ep2
programme.desc: Meteor and Ryusei attempt to uncover the true identities of the new transfer students, Mana Kuraishi and Minto Takigawa, but get caught. At night, a mysterious monster appears in the park!?

programme.title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life Ep3
programme.desc: An Eater appears during Meteor and Ryusei's Dungeon Date! What's more, a monster called a Tomath also appears at the school. Behind it all is a mysterious girl who wants the Dark Lord...!?

programme.title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life Ep4
programme.desc: School beauty Ayame Takanashi makes a move on Ryusei! Apparently, she used to be a totally different person..? Amid the escalating chaos, Sakura calls an emergency couples therapy session!?

programme.title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life Ep5
programme.desc: Ryusei's troubles are never-ending as a school teacher. While Meteor struggles with her sense of purpose, Ryusei offers encouragement. After school, their patrol somehow turns into a date!?

programme.title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life Ep6
programme.desc: Meteor transforms into a cat thanks to Minto! She enjoys her new form, even laying on Ryusei's lap. Later, Eriko Asahina, a magical girl from another world, appears and attacks Ryusei!?

programme.title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life Ep7

programme.title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life Ep8
programme.desc: Meteor launches a 'lap pillow' attack on Ryusei!? A rare item appears on a channel with a shocking price!? Many are intrigued by Ryusei when he visits Oz, though some have ulterior motives.

programme.title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life Ep9
programme.desc: A robot from another world bumps into Ryusei and falls in love with him. Meanwhile, Ayame is hassled by some bullies, and things take a sinister turn!? Later, the Mitsurugi Festival begins!

Li Hong has struggled to adapt to the pastoral life, however due to the direct and indirect help of Bao Yin she finally adapts to her new surroundings and falls in love with the land. Li Hong has struggled to adapt to the pastoral life, however due to the direct and indirect help of Bao Yin she finally adapts to her new surroundings and falls in love with the land.
